limits: Only one stationary world view on a Linux software renderer; no native GPU or Mac performance measurement.
Three pairs, always baseline first; not randomized, no significance or confidence interval claim.

The original third-pair candidate paused when the headless input helper exited. It and its valid preceding baseline are retained separately; the complete third pair was repeated after fixing the helper.
Separate JVMs reduce process carryover but OS file cache, JIT state, entities and thermal state can still vary.
Reported GC time is JVM collector-accounting time, not a JFR stop-the-world pause measurement.
RSS is sampled once per second and excludes a complete GPU/unified-memory accounting.
Tick-manager state is sampled after measured invocations, not completed-world-work or pause tracing.
These 180-second warmups with a camera fixture differ from the earlier 0.19 single pair; do not pool them.
The fixture camera enforcement and private clock/weather rules are not included in playable packs.
Matching settings and saved poses do not prove identical pixels, entity activity or exhaustive vanilla equivalence.
